asr.full_text: Hi there guys this is Nikhil from GreatDtech and in this video I am going to show you how you can earn money using bing search in India Microsoft search engine bing has tied up with freecharge to offer rewards to anyone who uses their bing search For every search that you do you get a point all you need to do is Come to the this website sign in using your hotmail or live account So you need to make sure that you are using the bing search and you have signed in using your microsoft account so me just open the bing search here so that's bing dot com now if I do this as a result the search, i just get a reward point now it's 15, now if i do the same thing once again, i wont get any additional point, so it was 15 earlier and it's 15th now, so i need to do unique searches every time to earn points, and if we go back to our dashboard, we have some information over here, so these are total searches every time to earn points as you can see I have already reached and finished those points If you want to get the 30s freecharge coupon, you need to have at least 70 points and I have already made those points and redeem the others Most of the time, the search results from bing and google won't vary a lot but i have just been using the bing search for 20 or 30 days so Google is definitely using this Bing search for a while now, so I would definitely recommend Binge search Every time I try to search in some place like a bing park or a movie theatre, on the Bing search it will give me some information, whereas on a google search, it'll have a pretty location based information nice location based info Let me show you an example The search is done with imax & the location. If I do the same with google. It'll give many better presentations It gives me a much better presentation Anyway, you can survive a Month in without any problem, but doing BING search will definitely appreacate Google more. So just do as a small experiment So going on next to take a complete advantage of this Change your default search engines from Google to Bing So it will help you a lot more You can change your default search engine from google to Bing To help earn new points much quicker Or else you can daily do some 10 random searches First thing in the morning And go back to google search as usual To change the default search engine in your browser Or the google chrome specifically Go to settings Once in settings, you have this category for search and just select the google, drop down box and select bing And now if i do any search, it will take me directly to the BING search So let me just go back to bing dashboard Refresh the page, and as you can see i have earned 3 credit or 3 points so far So there you have it guys In this way we can earn easily some money Approximately 100 for using bing search for 30 days And that's pretty much it Once you have the required amount of points you can redeemed that for the Coupons, and when you redeemed the points, you will get the coupon code, and you can go to free charge ,make any transaction and in the coupons page or the promo code section you can insert that coupon Let me just show you, how to do that. so just go to the free charge log into your account the free charge account can be from other account. promo code section enter the code that you get from the bing rewards page so once you apply the code that amount will be deducted in total amount so that's it guys in this way we can easily earn money by just doing bing search so that's it guys thanks for watching this video i hope you found this video to be helpful if you liked this video give me a thumbs up and share it with your friends and subscribe to my channel to see more videos just like this
